capabilities: Sync Google Tasks lists with the vault
Show tasks in a mobile-style sidebar widget
Embed interactive task tables in notes
Create, rename, and delete task lists
Filter, search, and sort tasks by date or title
extras: Tokens and credentials stay in the vault's data.json; OAuth uses a short-lived local server; no telemetry. Setup requires enabling the Google Tasks API and adding your email as an OAuth test user.
problem: Obsidian has no connection to Google Tasks, so tasks kept in Google's service stay invisible and unmanageable inside the vault.

relations.evidence: seamlessly connects your vault to Google Tasks
Setting a due date syncs directly to your Google Calendar as an all-day task deadline.

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Google Tasks integration that adds a sidebar task widget and embeddable interactive task tables with search, filters, and due-date sync.
